name: Juliet's Sol
source:
Where does the line of a person and their character blur? Could you love someone backstage the same as you do on the stage?

Jinx, the loveless Romeo, basks in all the attention she can get, especially that of the reliant Juliet, Avery. But, perhaps this love turned obsession makes the spotlight burn too bright.

[From [url=https://skelaxo.itch.io/juliets-sol]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个人及其性格的界限在哪里模糊？你能像在舞台上一样爱后台的某个人吗？

金克丝，无爱的罗密欧，沐浴在她能得到的所有关注中，尤其是依赖朱丽叶的艾弗里。但是，也许这种爱变成了痴迷，让聚光灯变得太亮了。

[来自[url=https://skelaxo.itch.io/juliets-sol]itch.io[/url]]
